name: Russian Village Business
storyline:
In Russian Village Business, you play as a young entrepreneur who has arrived in the Russian countryside as part of the "Russian Village Business" program to open a small shop and start selling groceries and essential goods.

You will take part in village life, influence its development, and help local residents cope with the challenges of rural living.
Your shop will become a point of attraction - a place where villagers can purchase everything they need to survive and prosper. Moreover, some residents will be able to sell their own products through your shop, which will affect their income, help them improve their homes, and even their personal lives.

In Russian Village Business, villagers live according to a daily schedule: they go to work, mind their own business, and from time to time need help from a savvy entrepreneur. Don’t hesitate to communicate - get to know them better, get a phone numbers, and find out whether they need anything beyond regular shopping.

In addition to the shop, the village features a local administration building, a post office, a rural community center, and a local police station - all worth visiting to fully immerse yourself in village affairs.

Russian Village Business combines elements of a shop management simulator, everyday life simulation, and a sandbox game, all set in the spirit of the Russian province - with humor, warmth, and recognizable characters and situations.
summary: Become a young entrepreneur who arrives in the Russian countryside and opens a village shop. Buy and sell goods, upgrade your store, and make this village great again - just like in the good old days!
